notes:
Summary: Verdigris builds a multi-tenant KB product for midmarket SaaS customers. Primary workload: SaaS customer KB RAG with embeddings + reranking.

Indexing scale: customer corpus ~35M documents (avg 3 vectors/doc => ~105M vectors). They expect to grow to ~80M docs in 12–18 months.

Traffic & latency targets: high QPS workload — steady-state 300–400 QPS with peaks 500–600 QPS. Desired end-to-end (ANN retrieval + cross-encoder rerank) p95 < 180ms, p99 < 300ms for product search flows. Cost target: aspirational cost per query <= $0.015 for typical two-stage pipeline (coarse retrieval + rerank).

Architecture preference: hosted API (no private control plane initially). Two-stage retrieval: approximate nearest neighbor index for candidate set (embedding-based), then a cross-encoder reranker (smaller cross-encoder for latency). They want Redwood Optimize recommendations (batching, quantization, kernel profiles) to hit cost/latency targets.

Security/compliance: SAML SSO required for internal admin console; audit logging for query provenance; per-region data residency: EU for EU customers, US for NA customers (customer-wide policy). KMS integration for encrypting keys is desirable. Retention controls for user-submitted content (30/90/365d) needed.

POC specifics and asks:
- Customer will provide 1M-doc sample + traffic trace for 14-day simulated load.
- Redwood to run embedding cost estimate and propose ANN config (index flavor, shard sizing) and reranker VM sizing.
- Load test target: sustained 500 QPS for 1 hour, burst 600 QPS.
- Provide clear per-query cost model for hosted API (embeddings calls + reranker compute + ANN storage).

Quotes from call: "If we can't get sub-0.02/query for our reranked flows we can't hit pricing targets for customers" — Head of Product.

Risk items / open questions:
- Can hosted API provide EU residency guarantees for segmented customers? (legal asked).
- SSO SAML test: Verdigris IdP team needs metadata/certs; timeline 3–4 weeks.
- Re-ranking latency under high QPS with caching/prefix-KV needs validation.

Recommended next steps:
1) Share security questionnaire answers and EU residency SLA language (security doc link).
2) Complete SAML test with Verdigris Staging IdP.
3) Ingest 1M-doc POC and run Redwood Optimize baseline; produce 500 QPS load test report with cost breakdown.

Stubs/links: pricing deck and security FAQ provided (drive links above). SE notes: prefer small-quantized reranker model for p99 headroom; leverage prefix caching for common queries.
arra_notes: Customer expects to convert to annual contract if POC meets latency and cost goals; procurement cycle ~6 weeks after POC.
